newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adsteam's IEL tax bill jumps to A$975 mln.
newsitem.headline: Adsteam's IEL tax bill jumps to A$975 mln.

text.p: Members of the former Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd group said on Wednesday the jointly-owned Industrial Equity Ltd (IEL) had received an additional tax bill, taking the total claim to A$975.14 million.

The companies - DJL Ltd, Tooth and Co Ltd and Residual Assco Group Ltd - said in a statement certain IEL companies had received further notices of amended assessment from the Australian Taxation Office for an aggregate A$66.7 million.
This followed previous assessments of A$31.4 million in March and A$876.9 million in July, they said in statements.
"Based on advice previously received, IEL directors believe the amount assessed is unrealistic," they said.
The statements said IEL would lodge objections to the new notices which related to the periods ended June 30, 1991, 1992 and 1993 and were due and payable on August 21, 1997.
It would also seek extension of time for payment.
